intent: An ancient Grashan sun-priestess's gown in pale ruin stone with terracotta bands and a terracotta sash, gold at the sun-disc headpiece and waist; from the high camera it reads as a narrow-waisted figure under a gold sun halo, opening into a closed tiered bell skirt that widens to a terracotta hem.
requests: A pale limestone or sandstone material for the stone pieces; Slate is the closest muted stone in the armour palette.
A tapered or trapezoid panel builder for a smooth closed bell skirt; box panels give a stepped flare.
